title: Project Consultant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Consultant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

At Toluna, we keep the world’s biggest brands one step ahead of their markets, their competitors, and their customers. For 25+ years we’ve been a leader in consumer insights, and today we’re at the center of our industry’s biggest shift: the move to AI-powered research grounded in real human truth.


Brands come to us because we’ve solved a problem most of our industry is still wrestling with: how to move fast without losing trust in the answer. Speed comes from AI we’ve been developing in-house since 2019, always-on platforms, and a 79M+ validated consumer community across 100+ countries.


Introduction:

Responsible for managing Toluna's market research projects, the Project Consultant will be representing Toluna to our wide range of clients in the global market. The goal is to work on and coordinate projects from beginning to end under strict timelines, handling multiple projects simultaneously and interacting with Toluna’s internal operations teams while providing the best service to our clients. The Project Consultant will deliver a great client experience by meeting clients' strategic insights needs and will be supporting US-based clients while reporting to the North American-based client services team.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide exceptional client service while cultivating strategic, long-term partnerships
  • Advocate for clients’ needs to ensure alignment with project objectives and service standards
  • Demonstrate expertise in the Toluna Start platform and champion its use with clients
  • Independently manage full service, field & tab, and assisted-DIY research projects
  • Review and optimize questionnaire logic, providing recommendations to clients
  • Manage workload successfully by planning and prioritising all tasks and projects
  • Support clients and internal teams in achieving clients' research objectives
  • Liaise with other internal departments and external partners
  • Devise detailed internal and client project plans and ensure client needs are met and exceeded where possible
  • Check and compare actual project requirements against cost
  • Be the point of contact of our clients
  • Program surveys or work with internal programming team (according to agreed rules)
  • Ensure programming edits are implemented accurately, and survey test link is checked before sending to client
  • Manage overall project coordination, monitoring schedules, project margins, key deliverables, and client expectations
  • Update client on progress at regular intervals and provide regular fieldwork updates to the client
  • Perform data quality checks, including regular review and removal of poor-quality open-ended responses
  • Monitor fieldwork either fielded by you or fielded by the Field management team (according to agreed rules)


Your profile:

  • Experience: Minimum of 4 years in a project management role within market research, with expertise in managing complex projects
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced understanding of survey programming, questionnaire logic, and data metrics. Familiarity with programming platforms like Toluna Start, Confirmit, or related tools is essential
  • Project Management: Proven ability to independently manage multiple high-complexity projects while meeting tight deadlines
  • Artificial Intelligence: Proactive in adopting and leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, insight generation, and overall project performance
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to build client relationships and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Languages: Advanced English is mandatory; additional language skills are a plus.
  • Professional Traits: Proactive, adaptable, and self-motivated, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Approaches challenges with initiative, resourcefulness, and a positive drive to deliver results and can work independently while contributing effectively to team objectives.


Our Values:

A cting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability

B ringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial

C ollaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness

D iscussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly

E mbracing empathy- Being egoless & caring


What we offer:

At Toluna, we’re all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, unlimited access to Udemy Business, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. If you’re passionate about making an impact on colleagues around the globe, we’d love to have you on board.


Other Benefits: Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, meal voucher, transportation voucher TotalPass, and language class subsidy.


Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

title: AI Agent Builder & Automation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Agent Builder & Automation Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Beige is looking for an exceptional, high-energy AI Agent Builder & Automation Engineer to join our technology team, architect cutting-edge automation ecosystems, and revolutionize our internal workflows and client-facing infrastructure.

This is not a traditional, slow-paced administrative or IT support role. You will operate as a critical driver of our company-wide digital transformation, taking extreme ownership of building custom AI agents, linking data pipelines, and eliminating manual operational bottlenecks for a rapidly growing media technology startup.

If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, possesses advanced technical skills across modern AI/LLM frameworks, and is obsessed with workflow efficiency and flawless automation logic, we want to hear from you.

About Beige

Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale.

Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform.

We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content.

As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth.

Location & Schedule
  • Location: Remote (International / Global Talent)
  • Schedule: Must be fully available to operate, test, and collaborate during our standard business coverage hours (aligned with US Central Standard Time / Pacific Standard Time). Flexibility is required to deploy urgent solutions during platform rollout phases.
Compensation
  • 600/Month


What You'll Be Doing

  • Custom AI Agent Architecture: Design, build, test, and deploy intelligent, multi-turn AI agents tailored for specific department use cases (HR, Sales, Customer Support, and Production).
  • Workflow Automation Pipelines: Architect seamless integrations and robust automation workflows between external platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, CRMs, email) and internal infrastructure.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Craft complex system prompts, build conversational logic chains, and continually refine LLM context windows to reduce errors and ensure highly accurate outputs.
  • System Integration: Utilize modern API integrations and automation hubs to sync data across disparate platforms, completely eliminating repetitive manual data entry.
  • System Optimization & Maintenance: Audit existing team workflows, identify manual bottlenecks, and maintain custom tools to keep systemic operational friction at absolute zero.
Who We're Looking For Required Qualifications:
  • Strong English Proficiency: High fluency in written and spoken English with exceptional technical and team communication skills.
  • Proven Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience building functional AI apps, custom bots, or comprehensive automation pipelines in a startup or fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Software & Logic Mastery: Expert-level fluency with automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, Microsoft Power Automate) and conversational AI/LLM deployment tools (e.g., OpenAI API, Claude/Anthropic, custom agent frameworks).
  • Technical Hardware Setup: A reliable, high-speed internet connection, dedicated workstation, and a stable power backup/electricity supply to maintain uninterrupted development operations.
  • Project Portfolio: A comprehensive list, case studies, or working live demos of AI agents, bots, or automated systems you have custom-built and successfully deployed.
Preferred / Major Plus:
  • Base familiarity or coding proficiency in languages used for advanced integrations (Python, JavaScript/JSON, SQL).
  • Deep experience setting up custom CRM automated workflows and managing complex follow-up automation architecture.
  • Prior exposure to media production, marketplace apps, or creative agency environments.
Core Behavioral Expectations:

To succeed in this role, you must be obsessed with operational efficiency and logic. You need to welcome rapidly shifting technical requirements, accept constructive feedback with professionalism, and actively prefer building scalable, intelligent systems over band-aid, low-impact administrative routines.

title: Senior DevOps with Terraform (BRL 17K/month CLT + bonus + benefits)

Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps with Terraform (BRL 17K/month CLT + bonus + benefits) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Description

This is a full-time Senior DevOps Engineer role, based on-site in the Greater São Paulo Area. The position emphasizes a security-first approach with a strong focus on managing infrastructure using Terraform. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing, implementing, and maintaining robust infrastructure solutions, optimizing Kubernetes clusters, and streamlining CI/CD pipelines for increased operational efficiency. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless system integration and secure software development environments will also be a key component of the role.


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Infrastructure as Code tools, particularly Terraform.
  • Strong expertise in Kubernetes for container orchestration and deployment.
  • Comprehensive experience in Linux environments and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge in Continuous Integration and software integration processes.
  • Proven background in software development, with a focus on automation and system reliability.
  • Ability to approach tasks with a security-first mindset.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills for interdisciplinary teamwork.
  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a strong advantage.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.

title: Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior


A Systax é uma empresa especializada em soluções tecnológicas para a área tributária. Ela oferece serviços que visam automatizar e otimizar a gestão fiscal das empresas, ajudando-as a lidar com a complexidade do sistema tributário brasileiro.


A Systax é conhecida por sua base de dados tributária, que é uma das mais completas do país, com +29 milhões de regras tributárias, abrangendo os 27 estados da federação. Além disso, fornece ferramentas que auxiliam na correta aplicação da legislação fiscal, minimizando riscos e aumentando a eficiência operacional. A empresa frequentemente realiza eventos e palestras para discutir atualizações e tendências na área, especialmente no momento com a Reforma tributária. Conheça mais sobre a Systax em


Por que entrar para o time Systax?


  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: Nos comunicamos de forma clara, prática e concisa, com uma mentalidade global e uma postura incansavelmente construtiva.
  • Propósito e aprendizado contínuo: Trabalhamos com propósito e utilizamos ferramentas tecnológicas para promover agilidade no aprendizado e na evolução constante.
  • Agilidade e colaboração: Agimos com senso de urgência e compartilhamos continuamente o que aprendemos, com foco em interações frequentes, velocidade e resiliência.
  • Tomada de decisão orientada por tecnologia: Conduzimos decisões e influenciamos resultados por meio da tecnologia, adaptando-nos rapidamente quando novas informações surgem.
  • Foco em resultados e valor ao cliente: Somos donos dos resultados, apoiamos a inovação de forma objetiva, documentamos decisões e avaliamos nosso trabalho sempre com foco na entrega de valor ao cliente.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Produtos SAP Sênior que atuará no desenvolvimento, evolução e sustentação de soluções fiscais integradas ao SAP S/4HANA, com foco em Tax Service. A posição exige conhecimento técnico-funcional em cenários fiscais SAP, com capacidade de apoiar projetos, analisar requisitos de negócio, orientar times internos e contribuir para a estabilidade e evolução do produto, com ênfase em determinação de impostos, integração com motor de cálculo externo e legislação tributária brasileira.


RESPONSABILIDADES DA VAGA:


  • Atuar na implementação, evolução e suporte de soluções de Tax Service integradas ao SAP;
  • Configurar, analisar e orientar processos fiscais nos módulos SD e MM, com interface desejável em FI;
  • Realizar e apoiar integrações do SAP com motor de cálculo externo, contribuindo para a consistência funcional e técnica da solução;
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar ocorrências relacionadas ao cálculo de tributos, incluindo ICMS, ICMS ST, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS, IBS e CBS;
  • Conduzir troubleshooting de pricing procedures, tax procedures, condition types, tax codes e payloads de integração em JSON/XML;
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas fiscal, tecnologia, produto e negócios, assegurando aderência à legislação tributária vigente e alinhamento entre necessidade funcional e solução sistêmica.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS/OBRIGATÓRIOS:


  • Experiência sólida om SAP, preferencialmente em cenários fiscais e de integração;
  • Conhecimento avançado em determinação de impostos no SAP, incluindo tax procedure e condition technique;
  • Experiência prática nos módulos SD e MM, com entendimento desejável de impactos e interfaces em FI;
  • Bons conhecimentos da legislação tributária brasileira, contemplando ICMS, ICMS ST, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS, IBS e CBS;
  • Experiência com NF-e e demais documentos fiscais eletrônicos;
  • Atuação em análise de erros e troubleshooting;
  • Conhecimento em integrações por APIs, RFCs e middleware, como SAP CPI/PI, com capacidade de interlocução entre times funcionais e técnicos;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.


FORMAÇÃO NECESSÁRIA:


Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas , compatível com atuação técnico-funcional em SAP e processos fiscais.


REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS – DIFERENCIAL:


  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA – Tax Service;
  • Vivência em integração com motores fiscais (Tax Service);
  • Vivência em projetos de implementação, além de suporte;
  • Conhecimento em debug ABAP em nível funcional/técnico.


Benefícios


  • Convênio médico SulAmérica (coparticipação).
  • Convênio odontológico SulAmérica.
  • Seguro-viagem nacional e internacional.
  • Vale refeição (Flex).
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Auxílio filho com deficiência.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Wellhub (Gympass).
  • LinkedIn Learning (Acesso a mais de 21 mil cursos, em diversas áreas).
  • CEFIS - Plataforma de Conhecimento (Acesso a mais de 500 cursos de capacitação e atualização profissional).
  • Parceria de desconto em cursos/treinamentos de SAP.
  • Parceria de desconto em cursos de inglês.
  • Outras facilidades e parcerias de descontos.


Outras Informações


  • Carga horária: das 9:00h às 18:00h
  • Modalidade: Híbrido
  • Cidade: São Paulo - SP


Como se Candidatar: Se você está interessado(a) nessa oportunidade, aplique-se diretamente através do link da vaga.

title: Senior Backend Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Exposure
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer – DevOps & Cloud Exposure em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Java Spring experience. This is not a standard backend role — it's designed for engineers who are technically broad, adaptable, and comfortable operating across development, operations, and cloud environments.


At Qubika , we design, develop, and deploy custom software solutions for organizations making an impact through technology.


What you'll do:

  • Develop and maintain backend solutions using Java Spring / Spring Boot
  • Support applications deployed in Kubernetes and AWS-based cloud environments
  • Maintain and troubleshoot Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD workflows
  • Contribute to scripting and automation tasks as needed (Python or similar)
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and DevOps teams on platform-related activities
  • Adapt to changing client priorities and a broad range of technical requests

What we're looking for

  • Strong Java Spring / Spring Boot experience
  • Practical knowledge of Kubernetes (clusters, pods, deployments, troubleshooting)
  • Familiarity with AWS services: EKS, IAM, Parameter Store, Secrets Manager, Security Groups
  • Experience with Jenkins pipelines and GitLab CI/CD
  • Basic understanding of Terraform and IaC concepts
  • Scripting skills in Python or equivalent
  • Resilience and adaptability in dynamic, fast-changing environments

Good to have

  • Previous experience in the financial services industry
  • Background in mixed roles combining development and operational tasks

What we offer:

  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Various benefits include flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. title: AWS Engineer (Security & Backend)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AWS Engineer (Security & Backend) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We have active HIPAA-related projects in flight — and we need an AWS engineer who can own the infrastructure and security layer. This is not a plug-and-play setup role. We need someone who thinks in systems, writes infrastructure as code, and understands that a misconfigured IAM policy in a healthcare context is not a learning opportunity — it's a liability. The backend work will be handled with AI-augmented development, so the right person will focus on architecture, security posture, and compliance — not boilerplate.

The Role
  • Design and implement HIPAA-compliant AWS infrastructure from the ground up (or audit/harden existing setups)
  • Configure IAM policies, VPCs, KMS encryption, and CloudTrail audit logging
  • Ensure PHI never touches a public subnet — and that the team understands why
  • Set up and manage audit logging pipelines (CloudTrail + CloudWatch + AWS Config)
  • Define and enforce encryption at rest and in transit across all relevant services
  • Write infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CDK
  • Work alongside our dev team and advise on security decisions throughout the project lifecycle
  • Potentially own backend development for net-new projects (scoped separately)
Requirements
  • AI Proficiency (Mainly in Claude.ai)
  • AWS Core
  • IAM — least-privilege policies, roles, SCPs, MFA enforcement
  • VPC — private/public subnet design, security groups, NACLs, VPC endpoints
  • KMS — encryption at rest (S3, RDS, EBS), key rotation, customer-managed keys
  • CloudTrail + CloudWatch + AWS Config — audit logging is a hard HIPAA requirement
  • Secrets Manager — zero hardcoded credentials, ever
  • RDS/Aurora or DynamoDB with encryption and automated backups
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Terraform or AWS CDK — security config lives in code, not in console clicks
  • Security posture
  • GuardDuty, Security Hub, and ideally Prowler for compliance scanning
  • Solid understanding of which AWS services are HIPAA-eligible and which are not
  • Knows what a BAA is and why it matters before a single byte of PHI goes anywhere
  • Regulated environment experience
  • 3+ years hands-on AWS experience
  • Prior exposure to at least one regulated workload — HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, or LGPD — is a strong plus
  • Comfortable working with a remote, async team

Nice to have

  • AWS Security Specialty or Solutions Architect Professional certification
  • Experience with Supabase or PostgreSQL in regulated contexts
  • Claude Certification

title: Executivo Comercial (Full-cycle)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executivo Comercial (Full-cycle) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOBRE A STORICA


The Creative Performance Company. Unimos estratégia, criativo, mídia, CRM, dados e consultoria para transformar marketing em crescimento previsível e mensurável.


Construímos sistemas de crescimento que conectam branding, performance e receita. Partimos de diagnóstico, definimos hipóteses, criamos, testamos, aprendemos e escalamos. É assim que entregamos crescimento sustentável para marcas reconhecidas, com cases premiados em performance.


Com base em Brasília e atuação em todo o Brasil, somos parceiros de marcas que querem converter atenção em valor real e presença em resultado. Se você quer fazer parte de um time que une visão estratégica, performance e criatividade para gerar impacto de negócio, aqui é o seu lugar.


VAGA: EXECUTIVO COMERCIAL (FULL-CYCLE)


Buscamos um Executivo Comercial para conduzir o ciclo de vendas da Storica de ponta a ponta. São vendas consultivas de média complexidade, que exigem entender o cenário do cliente, enquadrar a necessidade e desenhar o escopo do trabalho junto com ele. A posição é full-cycle: você domina todas as etapas, da qualificação ao fechamento, com autonomia para conduzir o relacionamento comercial e influenciar a forma como a Storica vende.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


• Qualificar as oportunidades com critério, reconhecendo o cliente certo para o método da Storica: empresas com maturidade e orçamento para investir de forma consistente em marketing digital.

• Conduzir diagnósticos consultivos para entender o estágio de maturidade em marketing de cada empresa e propor o caminho adequado entre as frentes da Storica: estratégia, criativo, mídia, CRM, dados e consultoria.

• Elaborar e apresentar propostas comerciais, com clareza de escopo, valor e objetivos de crescimento.

• Negociar e fechar contratos de forma sustentável, garantindo margem saudável e clientes alinhados ao perfil da agência.

• Gerenciar pipeline e previsibilidade de vendas em CRM, com cadência de follow-up, forecast e registro de oportunidades.

• Trabalhar próximo aos times de atendimento e estratégia para assegurar uma transição fluida entre venda e operação, preservando a clareza de expectativa e a qualidade do fit comercial.

• Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (oportunidades trabalhadas, taxa de conversão, receita nova, retenção de contratos) e reportar resultados periodicamente.


REQUISITOS ESSENCIAIS


• Experiência comprovada em venda consultiva B2B dentro do mercado de marketing digital, agência ou serviços de marketing. Requisito eliminatório, não diferencial. Procuramos quem já vendeu esse tipo de serviço e conhece o setor por dentro.

• Maturidade e repertório para conduzir uma reunião de fechamento com autonomia, enquadrar a necessidade do cliente e sustentar valor sem recorrer a preço.

• Capacidade de operar o ciclo completo de vendas com autonomia e total responsabilidade sobre o próprio funil.

• Domínio de negociação, diagnóstico e fechamento consultivo de contratos com recorrência mensal.

• Disciplina de pipeline e familiaridade com CRM (HubSpot, Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similar) e metodologias de funil (SPIN, BANT, GPCT).

• Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, com argumentação ancorada em dados e em valor.


Não buscamos vendedor de varejo nem consultor de vendas sem vivência no mercado de marketing. Também não é a posição certa para quem só rende com oportunidades entregues prontas por uma estrutura de pré-venda. Aqui você conduz o ciclo do início ao fim.


DESEJÁVEL


• Vivência com venda de serviços de marketing digital, growth ou branding com ticket recorrente.

• Conhecimento de métricas de performance (CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, margem) no nível de leitura executiva.

• Repertório no ciclo consultivo completo: qualificação, diagnóstico, proposta, fechamento e passagem para o onboarding.

• Boa compreensão de como marcas crescem a partir de dados, estratégia e execução integrada.


NOSSO TIME VAI GOSTAR SE VOCÊ…


• Entende que crescimento sustentável depende de qualidade de cliente, não de volume.

• Gosta de trabalhar com método e previsibilidade, medindo resultado e buscando evolução constante.

• É curioso e propositivo, não se limita a seguir script: questiona, sugere, melhora o processo.

• Se comunica com clareza, organiza o próprio pipeline e entrega o que promete.

• Enxerga o marketing como um sistema integrado de crescimento, e valoriza o equilíbrio entre performance e marca.


O QUE OFERECEMOS


• Estrutura sólida, com metodologia própria de crescimento e visão de longo prazo.

• Atuação com marcas relevantes de diferentes setores (educação, finanças, saúde, varejo, indústria).

• Cultura de autonomia, aprendizado e melhoria contínua.

• Distribuição de lucro uma vez por ano.

• Day-off no seu aniversário.

• Modelo híbrido, com base em Brasília.

• Contratação PJ, com fixo mais variável recorrente sobre os contratos fechados.


FAIXA DE REMUNERAÇÃO


• Fixo mensal de R$ 4.000.

• Variável recorrente sobre os contratos fechados.

• Ao atingir as metas projetadas, o ganho total mensal, somando fixo e variável, gira entre R$ 8.000 e R$ 12.000.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure DevOps Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer

Duration: 6+ Months

Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.

The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.

CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.

Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

This role directly supports execution of the business strategy and is responsible for driving:

  • Sustained revenue growth in the highest-value region in Brazil;

  • Development of strategic distributor;
  • Strengthening demand generation initiatives and pipeline robustness;

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

  • English Intermediate level required;
  • Willingness to travel frequently;
  • Proven experience working with distributors and/or wholesalers;

title: Coordenador/a de Administração Contratual (Atuação em Obras)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador/a de Administração Contratual (Atuação em Obras) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção, maior construtora pesada do Brasil está com uma oportunidade para Coordenador/a de Administração Contratual, com foco em obras rodoviárias na cidade de Ponta Grossa/PR . Este/a profissional será responsável por coordenar estrategicamente a gestão contratual do projeto, assegurando a conformidade legal, o equilíbrio econômico-financeiro dos contratos e a mitigação de riscos, além de atuar na interface com stakeholders relevantes, tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Coordenar a administração contratual de contratos de obras de infraestrutura de grande porte, com forte atuação em projetos rodoviários;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica na identificação, gestão e mitigação de riscos contratuais e financeiros;
  • Realizar a análise e interpretação de contratos, editais, propostas técnicas e comerciais, identificando riscos e oportunidades;
  • Conduzir processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro dos contratos;
  • Estruturar, elaborar e sustentar reivindicações (claims) e negociações contratuais junto ao cliente;
  • Participar e acompanhar dispute boards, comitês de resolução de disputas e arbitragens;
  • Atuar na interface direta com poder concedente, concessionárias, autarquias públicas e entidades privadas;
  • Coordenar a elaboração e controle de documentos contratuais, incluindo notificações, aditivos, relatórios, cronogramas e termos de encerramento;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais, legais e regulatórias (compliance, seguros, garantias e licenças);
  • Implantar e gerir sistemas de gestão eletrônica de documentos (GED), assegurando organização e rastreabilidade contratual;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente as áreas de engenharia, planejamento e jurídica na gestão de escopo, prazos, custos e compliance;
  • Acompanhar indicadores contratuais, prazos, riscos e conformidades regulatórias;
  • Assegurar a adequada utilização da documentação de concorrência e contratação (editais, cartas convite, consultas, legislação aplicável, etc.).


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Contratos, Direito Contratual ou Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Vivência comprovada com contratos públicos e privados como Coordenador/a de Administração Contratual em obras de grande porte do segmento rodoviário (Rodovias, Estradas, OAEs, Pavimentação, etc.);
  • Experiência em coordenação de equipes;
  • Conhecimentos aprofundados quanto a legislação aplicável (Lei de Licitações, contratos privados e regulação de concessões);
  • Dominar as diversas estruturas de modalidades contratuais utilizadas nos mercados mais competitivos mundialmente (Preços Unitários, preço global, LSTK, Aliança, EPCM, entre outros;
  • Forte experiência em claims, reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro e gestão de disputas;
  • Habilidades avançadas de negociação, comunicação e visão analítica;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em obra na cidade de Ponta Grossa/PR.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure DevOps Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer

Duration: 6+ Months

Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.

The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.

CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.

Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Creative Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Creative Director em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Creative Director

Talent Global LLC — Remote

Part-Time (10 hrs/week) | US Time Zones | Long-Term Contract


About the Role

Our client is a US-based performance marketing agency that builds and scales creative content for brands across paid social and digital channels. They are looking for a Creative Director to serve as the internal quality gate for all creative output — both video and graphics — before it reaches the client. This person will work closely with the agency's leadership team, taking ownership of creative review, direction, and strategy across active accounts.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and QA all video and graphic creative assets before client delivery, ensuring quality, brand alignment, and strategic clarity
  • Provide clear, actionable creative direction to designers and video editors based on client briefs and performance goals
  • Develop creative strategies for new content batches — defining concept, visual direction, messaging angle, and format
  • Identify creative weaknesses across active accounts and propose improvements proactively
  • Maintain a high creative bar across all output, with strong attention to detail in both visual execution and storytelling


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Senior Art Director, or equivalent role at a marketing agency or performance-focused creative team
  • Strong portfolio spanning both video and graphic content — social ads, brand content, or performance creative
  • Ability to both review/direct existing work and develop new creative strategies from scratch
  • Deep understanding of what makes creative perform on paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Experience working with or managing designers and video editors
  • Excellent written and verbal English — able to communicate creative feedback clearly and professionally
  • Self-directed and highly detail-oriented — comfortable working async with a lean team
  • Familiarity with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, or similar) is a plus


Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who has a natural eye for what's working and what isn't — and can articulate why with precision. They thrive in fast-moving agency environments where standards are high and feedback cycles are tight. They are equally comfortable directing a video edit and reviewing a static ad set, and they understand that creative strategy and execution are inseparable. They don't need to be reminded to raise the bar — they set it.

title: AI Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're partnering with a global software organization that is investing heavily in AI-driven products, automation, and intelligent workflow solutions. This is an opportunity to join a growing AI & Automation team focused on building real-world applications that deliver measurable business value. The team is moving beyond experimentation and proof-of-concepts into production-grade systems used by customers and internal stakeholders.


About the Role

If you're a software engineer who uses AI to build better software, not someone who simply prompts AI tools, this could be a strong fit.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy production-ready software solutions
  • Build AI-enabled applications and automation workflows
  • Evaluate and implement new technologies through rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept development
  • Collaborate with engineering and business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and technical best practices
  • Integrate AI services, APIs, and automation platforms into business applications
  • Help drive the adoption of modern software development practices, including AI-assisted development


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience


Required Skills

  • Strong software design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience building and supporting production applications
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools
  • Experience with workflow automation and process orchestration
  • Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and modern application architectures
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and work across multiple projects


Technical Environment

Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:

  • .NET/ C#
  • Node.js
  • React
  • JavaScript / TypeScript
  • PostgreSQL
  • MongoDB or document databases
  • REST APIs
  • Cloud platforms (Azure or AWS)
  • AI integrations and automation platforms
  • Claude
  • CodeRAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • n8n or similar workflow automation tools

What Makes Someone Successful Here

This team is looking for engineers who:

  • Can take a concept from idea to production
  • Know when AI-generated code is useful and when it needs refinement
  • Understand software engineering fundamentals beyond prompting tools
  • Enjoy solving business problems through automation
  • Thrive in environments where new technologies are evaluated and adopted quickly

What This Role Is Not

This is not a machine learning research position. This is not a prompt engineering role. This is a hands-on software engineering position focused on building production applications that leverage AI and automation technologies.


Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Work on AI-enabled products that are actively being deployed
  • Join a team focused on innovation and delivery
  • Exposure to modern AI, automation, and software development practices


Fully remote within Brazil

This is a CLT Role - Compensation is R$15,000/month

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Azure DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • We are seeking a highly skilled and creative Senior Azure DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership and drive the evolution of our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. In this role, you will not only manage progress on critical projects and provide high-level support, but you will also serve as the technical anchor for our DevOps practices.
  • The ideal candidate blends deep technical proficiency in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem with the creative problem-solving skills required to build elegant, scalable, and secure automation frameworks.


Location: 40% Remote and 60% onsite in São Paulo, Brazil (Paraiso district) - onsite 1 week every 2-3 weeks


Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership: Serve as the subject matter expert on Azure DevOps practices, guiding project architecture and mentoring team members without the burden of administrative people-management.
  • Project Delivery & Support: Ensure steady, measurable progress on core engineering projects while providing robust tier-3 infrastructure and pipeline support.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design, build, and maintain modular, multi-environment (Dev/Test/Prod) infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates, ensuring strict adherence to state and drift management best practices.
  • CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize sophisticated, multi-stage YAML-based Azure DevOps pipelines to automate infrastructure and application deployments for multi-language stacks (.NET, Python, Node.js, Java).
  • DevSecOps Implementation: Integrate robust security gates, vulnerability scanners, and compliance checks directly into the CI/CD lifecycle.


Experience:

Technical Requirements

Azure Platform Expertise

  • IaC Tools: Proven experience with Terraform (utilizing remote state on Azure Storage), Bicep, or ARM.
  • Azure DevOps Services: Deep familiarity with the full ADO suite (Repos, Pipelines, Boards, Artifacts).
  • Scripting & Management: Proficiency with Azure CLI, PowerShell (Az module), and REST APIs.
  • Observability: Hands-on experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
  • Governance & Security: Strong grasp of Azure Policy, Blueprints, RBAC, and Azure Key Vault for secret/certificate management.
  • Containers & Serverless: Foundational knowledge of Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Helm, Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Functions, and App Services.


CI/CD & Deployment Strategies

  • Mastery of multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps (GitHub Actions is a strong plus).
  • Proven track record implementing advanced deployment strategies (Blue-Green, Canary, Rolling).
  • Experience integrating security scanning tools such as SonarQube, WhiteSource, or Snyk into automated pipelines.


Security & Enterprise Compliance

  • Comprehensive understanding of Secure DevOps practices and automated security gates (SCA, IaC scans).
  • Experience with Azure Active Directory (AAD) integration and MFA policies.
  • Familiarity with Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and enterprise security baselines is highly desirable.


What Will Make You Successful

  • Technical Proficiency: You have a battle-tested understanding of enterprise Azure environments and CI/CD mechanics. You don't just use tools; you know how they work under the hood.
  • Creativity: You look beyond standard templates to find innovative ways to optimize workflows, solve complex deployment bottlenecks, and design elegant technical solutions.
  • Drive for Progress: You are self-motivated to push projects across the finish line while maintaining high-quality support standards.

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Analista de Negócios e Inovação Junior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Negócios e Inovação Junior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Garantir a excelência no atendimento técnico e consultivo às seguradoras, atuando como o elo principal entre as necessidades do cliente e a entrega da solução. O desafio desta posição é realizar uma gestão \"ponta a ponta\" (end-to-end), combinando visão técnica para testes de sistema com uma postura de Sucesso do Cliente (CS) de nível 2. Os principais desafios são:

  • Compreender demandas complexas de seguradoras e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas;
  • Realizar testes precisos para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos solicitados;
  • Atuar com autonomia e agilidade como suporte de segunda camada;
  • Manter um relacionamento de confiança e alta qualidade com parceiros corporativos;
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações simultâneas com foco em resolução e prazo.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atender demandas críticas de seguradoras, realizando a análise inicial e o acompanhamento até a resolução final;
  • Realizar testes técnicos em sistemas para validar funcionalidades e comportamentos esperados;
  • Conduzir reuniões e chamadas de vídeo com clientes para alinhamento de expectativas e apresentações de soluções;
  • Redigir e-mails profissionais e técnicos, mantendo o cliente sempre posicionado sobre o status das demandas;
  • Atuar como Nível 2 de suporte, resolvendo problemas que exigem maior profundidade técnica e análise de processos;
  • Apoiar na melhoria contínua dos sistemas e fluxos de atendimento com base no feedback dos clientes.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Ensino superior (em andamento ou completo);
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita (essencial para contato direto com seguradoras);
  • Postura profissional e habilidade para realizar apresentações e reuniões online;
  • Conhecimento básico de informática e ferramentas de produtividade (E-mail, Pacote Office, Google Workspace);
  • Perfil organizado, com facilidade para aprender novos processos e sistemas rapidamente;
  • Proatividade e foco genuíno na resolução de problemas.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Conhecimento prévio sobre o mercado de seguros;
  • Experiência com atendimento B2B (Business to Business);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de chamados e gestão de demandas (Jira, Movidesk ou similares);
  • Noções básicas de tecnologia (ex.: entender estrutura de JSON, curiosidade para testar endpoints/APIs).

Somos referência no mercado de instrumentos musicais e equipamentos de áudio profissional, com um forte compromisso em democratizar o acesso a produtos de alta qualidade. Nosso time é movido pela inovação, aprendizado contínuo e foco no cliente, criando conexões que transformam vidas e negócios.

Nossa Cultura

Na Koala, valorizamos muito mais do que resultados: valorizamos como eles são alcançados. Somos uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, sempre guiados por propósito, colaboração e espírito de dono.

Nosso ambiente é:

- Desafiador, mas com suporte de um time que joga junto;

- Focado em performance, mas sem abrir mão do cuidado e da transparência.

Conheça nosso Código de Cultura da Koala - ele é o ponto de partida para tudo que construímos aqui.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de vendas digitais nas rotinas do dia a dia, com foco em aprendizado e desenvolvimento em performance;
  • Auxiliar na gestão de marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, entre outros), acompanhando anúncios e resultados de vendas;
  • Dar suporte na otimização de anúncios, garantindo qualidade, organização e alinhamento com a estratégia comercial;
  • Ajudar na criação de ações promocionais, como kits, combos e campanhas por canal;
  • Colaborar na criação e ajustes de páginas comerciais (landing pages);
  • Acompanhar concorrentes e tendências de mercado, apoiando na identificação de oportunidades;
  • Auxiliar na construção de relatórios e no acompanhamento de indicadores de vendas;
  • Apoiar o time com análises e sugestões de melhorias, sempre com orientação;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com marketing para apoiar campanhas e ações comerciais;
  • Desenvolver conhecimento contínuo sobre e-commerce, ferramentas e mercado digital;
  • Venda para revenda.


*Conhecimento ou interesse em produtos de áudio (microfones, caixas de som, etc.) é um diferencial.*


Buscamos pessoas com este perfil:

  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver na área comercial e de e-commerce;
  • Interesse por números, vendas e análise de resultados;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade e boa comunicação;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe;
  • Curiosidade e disposição para receber e aplicar feedbacks.
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em produtos de áudio (microfones, caixas de som, etc.) é um diferencial;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos na área.


Benefícios e Vantagens

  • Premiação por atingimento de meta;
  • Vale transporte/vale combustível;
  • Ambiente jovem, dinâmico e inovador;
  • Wellhub;
  • VA/VR;
  • Plano de Saúde (sem coparticipação e com plano odontológico);
  • Escritório moderno e inspirador em Porto Alegre (com café e boas conversas garantidas);
  • Descontos exclusivos em instrumentos musicais e equipamentos de áudio.

title: Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Architect (Databricks) - Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?


  • 8+ years of experience in Data, AI, or Machine Learning Engineering roles;
  • 3+ years of experience designing ML platforms or AI architecture at scale;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Python, and SQL;
  • Proficient understanding of MLOps, ML lifecycle management, distributed ML systems, feature engineering, and model deployment patterns;
  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture;
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP);
  • Proven ability to deploy ML models into production environments;
  • Strong knowledge of data architecture and scalable ETL/ELT patterns;
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Apache Airflow.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Desenvolvedora Java | Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO :


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções técnicas de média e alta complexidade, com boa autonomia, utilizando as tecnologias, frameworks e padrões adotados nos projetos da BU de Core Banking.
  • Analisar, compreender e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, avaliando componentes, integrações, estrutura, segurança e regras de negócio envolvidas.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir funcionalidades com foco em qualidade, desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade e aderência às necessidades do negócio.
  • Criar, manter e apoiar a evolução de testes manuais e automatizados, contribuindo para a confiabilidade das entregas e para a cobertura dos requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Participar ativamente da definição técnica das soluções, contribuindo com análises, sugestões de melhoria e apoio ao time na tomada de decisão.
  • Documentar implementações, fluxos, decisões técnicas e etapas do desenvolvimento, utilizando ferramentas de versionamento, rastreabilidade e documentação técnica.
  • Realizar detalhamento técnico de demandas em conjunto com clientes, analistas de negócio e demais áreas envolvidas, transformando requisitos funcionais em soluções viáveis, sustentáveis e aderentes à arquitetura definida.
  • Garantir a qualidade do software por meio da aplicação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisão de código, padronização e uso adequado de frameworks, servidores de aplicação e ferramentas corporativas.
  • Atuar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, analistas, QA e áreas parceiras, promovendo alinhamento técnico e funcional ao longo do ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas e funcionais com time e cliente, apoiando o esclarecimento de dúvidas, o refinamento de escopo e a evolução contínua das soluções.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Java (Java 8 e/ou 17).
  • Experiência com Keycloak, utilizando OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (Bearer Token)
  • Domínio de frameworks como Spring Boot, JAX-WS, JAX-RS, CDI, JPA, JEE, JSF, EJB e AngularJS e ferramentas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL e Oracle).
  • Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, Wildfly 11 e/ou 18 e práticas de CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST, GraphQL e integrações complexas.
  • Vivência com GIT e Maven (para build e gerenciamento de dependências)


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER :

  • Certificações Java ou em arquitetura de software.
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação digital e sistemas de grande escala.
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Certificações Oracle ou similares em arquitetura e desenvolvimento.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Supervisor de Hotelaria
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supervisor de Hotelaria em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos profissionais engajados que queiram fazer a diferença a partir do acolhimento, cuidado e excelência. Faça parte de um dos mais modernos complexos hospitalares do país, sendo referência brasileira pela qualidade e segurança de sua medicina e pelo humanismo de seus profissionais, contando com processos e equipamentos inovadores.


Desde 1º de agosto de 2018, a Santa Casa de Porto Alegre se tornou a nova mantenedora e administradora do Hospital Dom João Becker, em Gravataí, região metropolitana de Porto Alegre. A unidade agora passa a integrar o patrimônio do complexo hospitalar, atendendo tanto usuários do SUS, quanto de convênios e particulares. Única unidade hospitalar no município, o Hospital Dom João Becker oferece atendimentos nos setores de urgência, emergência, internação, UTI, centro obstétrico, laboratório de análises clínicas, centro de especialidades médicas, fisioterapia e diagnóstico por imagem. Em seus 13.000m² de área construída, o Hospital Dom João Becker possui 173 leitos de internação e 20 leitos de UTI.


O setor de Hotelaria Hospitalar é responsável por garantir ambientes limpos, organizados, seguros e acolhedores para pacientes, acompanhantes, visitantes e colaboradores. Por meio das equipes de higienização, atua diretamente na qualidade dos espaços hospitalares, contribuindo para a segurança, prevenção de infecções e bem-estar de todo

s.Mais do que cuidar da estrutura física, a área tem papel essencial na experiência e no acolhimento das pessoas, promovendo um ambiente mais humano, confortável e seguro.


Faça parte de uma equipe que contribui diariamente para o cuidado e bem-estar de pacientes, familiares e colaboradores.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir estratégias específicas de Higienização, administrando as atividades e estabelecendo as diretrizes de trabalho;
  • Garantir a referência em termos de ações de higienização, através do acompanhamento de pesquisas de satisfação, implementando e acompanhando os planos de ação correspondentes;
  • Supervisionar os Recursos Humanos, através do adequado dimensionamento de pessoal;
  • Identificar e promover programas de capacitação;
  • Interagir com as áreas internas com o objetivo de identificar e programar ações com foco no direcionamento estratégico de sua unidade e da instituição;
  • Planejar e acompanhar os recursos financeiros da área, garantindo a execução das atividades previstas na programação orçamentária;
  • Administrar consumos de materiais de manutenção e expediente;
  • Acompanhar a análise crítica mensal sobre o desempenho dos serviços de higienização, estabelecendo e acompanhando os planos de melhoria;
  • Gerenciar os indicadores estabelecidos, através da orientação, capacitação e desenvolvimento de sua força de trabalho;
  • Assegurar o atendimento às normas e procedimentos das unidades que compõem a UGB, definindo instruções de serviços e implementando estratégias de atendimento as expectativas dos clientes;
  • Assegurar a segurança dos colaboradores no desenvolvimento das tarefas;
  • Supervisionar todas as atividades da equipe, a fim de estabelecer padrão de trabalho em todas as unidades hospitalares.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo (Hotelaria, Administração ou áreas afins);
  • Necessário experiência com gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência em hospital será um diferencial.
